name: DELUX M900 Pro
author: Aeon Arc
description: Battery, DPI, polling rate, lighting and sensor settings of the DELUX M900 Pro wireless mouse in the Omarchy bar, over its 2.4G receiver and without the Windows driver.

barWidget.description: Battery level of the DELUX M900 Pro mouse; click for DPI, polling, lighting and sensor settings. Needs the udev rule from the plugin's README.

schema.label: Show percentage
schema.description: Show the battery percentage next to the mouse icon. Off leaves only the icon; the tooltip still has the level.
